blocks.text: Security rules decide which client reads and writes are allowed. Even a local exercise should name its intended collection and validate important fields.

Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: These are deliberately public local practice rules, not private-user production rules. Never deploy them as protection for private records.
